text:
incident-bot: Pager opened — svc-payments 5xx spike. Paging ria (oncall). Severity: high. Runbook: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/incident/1754326789>. :rotating_light:

ria (oncall): On it, joining bridge — ETA 2m. @samir can you shadow?

samir: On the bridge. grabbing logs now. seeing error waterfall from the canary deploy.

ria (oncall): We rolled back the canary and traffic normalized. Need to schedule the PIR — facilitator + backup + pre-read owners. Suggested 45m slot: Wed 9:00 PT / Thu 13:00 UTC as options.

kelly: I can facilitate the Wed 9:00 PT slot if that works. Happy to keep it tight (45m).

leo-cs: Include a short customer impact summary for AcmeCorp — they hit ~45% error rate for about 20m and retried causing downstream duplication. I can prep that slide.

jordan: I'll own action-item tracking and the runbook updates.

samir: I can be backup facilitator and do the initial RCA draft. Also will attach the deploy diff and relevant logs.

ria (oncall): Cool — locking Wed 2026-03-25 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC. Host: kelly. Backup: samir. Invite: eng, sres, cs (leo). Duration: 45m. Pre-read owners: leo-cs (impact) + ria (timeline/logs). Agenda: timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations, concrete action items + owners.

kelly: Confirmed. I'll create the calendar invite and add Zoom. Suggest we include these in the pre-read:
```
- deploy diff (git sha)
- error-rate graphs (1m/5m)
- relevant stack traces
- rollback steps executed
```

ria (oncall): I'll post a short incident summary and attach logs: `s3://redwood-incidents/1754326789/logs.tar.gz`. Also adding the incident doc in /incidents/1754326789.

incident-bot: PIR scheduled — Wed 2026-03-25 16:00:00 UTC. Reminder set for 24h before. Meeting doc: <https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/1754326789>.

samir: I'll draft the RCA after the meeting and open the PR for the runbook changes.

jordan: RSVP check — @samir @kelly @leo-cs @ria (oncall) @alex (infra) please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend.

alex (infra): +1. Will attend and bring infra-side deploy metrics.

leo-cs: I'll add the customer timeline to the pre-read and flag any open support tickets.

kelly: Invite created and sent. Zoom link + dial-ins in the calendar. Adding agenda to the doc.

ria (oncall): Thanks all. Postmortem facilitator: kelly. Backup: samir. Pre-read owners: leo-cs + ria. Action-tracker owner: jordan. See you Wed.

samir: Thanks — I'll chase the RCA skeleton and drop it in the doc before EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: Action: PIR scheduled, owner assignments recorded. Thread closed for scheduling — use the meeting doc for follow-ups.
__notes: single-thread Slack export style; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names. No title field included per agents.md.
